items.title_en: Zelensky praises Europe's 'real leaders' as ties with Trump sour
items.title_zh: 泽连斯基布鲁塞尔求援，称赞欧洲“真正的领导人”暗讽特朗普
items.search_zh: 泽连斯基 欧盟峰会 特朗普
items.summary_en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky received a warm welcome from European Union leaders at a summit in Brussels on Friday, as his relationship with US President Donald Trump continues to deteriorate. Zelensky thanked the "real leaders" in the room, a remark widely seen as a veiled swipe at Trump, who had criticised him in a Newsmax interview a day earlier. He asked the EU for about €70 billion in additional support for 2027, on top of a €90 billion EU loan that already covers this year and next. Zelensky also warned that Ukraine is "not a priority destination" for US-made Patriot air-defence missiles, as most interceptors are now being sent to the Middle East.
items.summary_zh: 周五，乌克兰总统泽连斯基在布鲁塞尔出席欧盟峰会，受到欧盟领导人的热烈欢迎，而他与美国总统特朗普的关系正持续恶化。泽连斯基感谢在场的“真正的领导人”，此话被普遍视为暗讽特朗普——特朗普前一天刚在接受Newsmax采访时批评过他。他请求欧盟为2027年追加约700亿欧元援助，这是在欧盟已承诺覆盖今明两年的900亿欧元贷款之外的额外资金。泽连斯基还警告，乌克兰并非美制“爱国者”防空导弹的“优先供应目的地”，目前大部分拦截弹都被送往中东。
items.why_zh: 美欧在援乌问题上的分歧会影响全球安全格局和能源价格；“veiled swipe（含蓄地讽刺）”这类表达在英文新闻和职场沟通中都很常见。

vocab.example: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky received a warm welcome from European Union leaders at a summit in Brussels on Friday, as his relationship with US President Donald Trump continues to deteriorate.
Zelensky thanked the "real leaders" in the room, a remark widely seen as a veiled swipe at Trump, who had criticised him in a Newsmax interview a day earlier.

explain.one_liner: 乌克兰总统去找欧洲要钱要武器，顺便暗戳戳地吐槽了美国总统特朗普。

facts.name: 乌克兰
facts.text: 2022 年起一直在和俄罗斯打仗，打仗的钱和武器很大一部分靠外国援助。

facts.name: 欧盟和美国
facts.text: 乌克兰最主要的两个“金主”。

facts.name: 最近的矛盾
facts.text: 特朗普对援助乌克兰越来越冷淡，前一天还在采访里批评了泽连斯基。

points: 感谢在场的“真正的领导人”，言下之意是“某些人不算”，被认为在讽刺特朗普。
向欧盟再要约 700 亿欧元，用在 2027 年（今明两年已经有 900 亿欧元贷款）。
抱怨美国的“爱国者”防空导弹大多送去了中东，乌克兰排不上号。
explain.relevance: 美国和欧洲在援助乌克兰上意见不合，会影响全球局势和油价、能源价格，澳洲也会受影响。

phrase.zh: 含蓄地讽刺、暗戳戳地损人

items.title_en: Senate blocks Labor's health insurance rebate cut for over-65s
items.title_zh: 参议院否决工党削减65岁以上人群私人医保返利计划
items.search_zh: 澳洲私人医保 返利 65岁 参议院
items.summary_en: The Senate has blocked the Albanese government's plan to remove the higher private health insurance rebate for Australians aged 65 and over, voting 38 to 23 to strike the bill from its agenda. The Coalition, the Greens, One Nation and several crossbench senators joined forces against the change, which was due to start in April 2027. The government says the measure would save about $3 billion over four years, which it plans to redirect to aged care, but the Greens will only support it if pensioners are exempted. Health Minister Mark Butler has reintroduced the same bill, while the Opposition warns that older couples could face premium increases of up to $1,614 a year.
items.summary_zh: 参议院以38票对23票将相关法案移出议程，阻止了阿尔巴尼斯政府取消65岁及以上澳洲人较高私人医保返利的计划。联盟党、绿党、一国党和多名中间派参议员联手反对这项原定于2027年4月实施的改革。政府称该措施四年可节省约30亿澳元，并计划将这笔钱转投养老护理，但绿党表示只有在豁免领取养老金者的情况下才会支持。卫生部长马克·巴特勒已重新提交了同一法案，而反对党警告称，老年夫妇每年的保费可能最多上涨1614澳元。
items.why_zh: 私人医保返利关系到很多家庭（包括父母辈）的保费支出；保险、医疗和养老行业的营销也会随政策变化调整定价和宣传。
items.source: The New Daily; The Senior; Canberra Times

vocab.example: The government says the measure would save about $3 billion over four years, which it plans to redirect to aged care, but the Greens will only support it if pensioners are exempted.
Health Minister Mark Butler has reintroduced the same bill, while the Opposition warns that older couples could face premium increases of up to $1,614 a year.

explain.one_liner: 政府想少给 65 岁以上老人一点私人医保补贴、把钱挪去做养老护理，结果在参议院被几个党联手挡住了。

facts.name: 工党 Labor
facts.text: 现在的执政党，总理是阿尔巴尼斯（Albanese）。这个计划就是他们提的。

facts.name: 联盟党 Coalition
facts.text: 自由党 + 国家党，最大的反对党。新闻里的 the Opposition 就是它。

facts.name: 绿党 Greens
facts.text: 偏左的小党，在参议院经常决定法案能不能通过。

facts.name: 一国党 One Nation
facts.text: 偏右的小党，领袖是 Pauline Hanson。

facts.name: 参议院 Senate
facts.text: 法案要众议院、参议院都通过才算数。工党在参议院不过半，需要别的党或独立议员（crossbench）支持。

facts.name: 私人医保返利 rebate
facts.text: 政府帮你付一部分私人医保保费，年纪越大补贴比例越高。

relations.b: 联盟党 + 绿党 + 一国党 + 部分独立议员
relations.label: 这次联手反对
有条件支持：领养老金的人要豁免

points: 参议院 38 票对 23 票，把这个法案移出了议程。
政府说这样四年能省约 30 亿澳元，拿去投养老护理（aged care）。
反对党说，老年夫妇每年保费可能最多多交 1,614 澳元。
卫生部长 Mark Butler 已经重新提交同一法案，事情还没完。
explain.relevance: 你或家里长辈买澳洲私人医保的话可以留意补贴政策在变；这也是看懂澳洲“政府提案 → 参议院卡住”这套流程的典型例子。

items.title_en: Huang Zitao and Xu Yiyang finally confirm they are parents
items.title_zh: 黄子韬徐艺洋官宣当爸妈，晒一家三口海边合影
items.search_zh: 黄子韬 徐艺洋 官宣 一家三口
items.summary_en: Former EXO member Huang Zitao and his wife Xu Yiyang have finally confirmed that they are parents, ending more than two years of speculation. On October 15, Xu posted sunset photos on Weibo that show the couple at the beach holding hands with a toddler, and the news quickly became one of the hottest topics on Chinese social media. The couple, who registered their marriage in December 2024 and held a wedding in Beijing in October 2025, had never directly confirmed rumours that they had a child, and their agency once issued a statement denying surrogacy claims. Many fans sent congratulations, but others questioned why the pair had stayed silent for so long, while the child's name, gender and date of birth remain undisclosed.
items.summary_zh: 前EXO成员黄子韬和妻子徐艺洋终于确认已为人父母，结束了两年多的猜测。10月15日，徐艺洋在微博发布一组夕阳照片，画面中两人在海边牵着一个已会走路的孩子，这一消息迅速成为中文社交媒体上最热门的话题之一。两人于2024年12月官宣领证，2025年10月在北京举办婚礼，此前从未正面承认过生子传闻，其经纪公司还曾发声明否认代孕传言。许多粉丝送上祝福，但也有人质疑两人为何沉默这么久，而孩子的名字、性别和出生日期至今仍未公开。
items.why_zh: 明星“官宣”时机和方式本身就是一种公关策略；这件事也说明，长期回避回应可能损害公众信任，对品牌危机公关很有参考价值。
items.source: Malay Mail; AsiaOne; Sina Entertainment (新浪娱乐)

vocab.example: Former EXO member Huang Zitao and his wife Xu Yiyang have finally confirmed that they are parents, ending more than two years of speculation.
Many fans sent congratulations, but others questioned why the pair had stayed silent for so long, while the child's name, gender and date of birth remain undisclosed.
